verdict.rationale: Cline supports MCP servers for external tool/data integration and ACP so third-party clients (editors, tools) can embed Cline as an agent, plus chat integrations (Slack, Discord, Telegram, Linear) and CI/CD pipeline embedding — all evidence of ecosystem interoperability. However there's no explicit evidence of a marketplace or catalog of partner-built 'agent apps' that can be dropped into Cline workflows the way MCP tools can. Missing for 10: a documented partner/agent marketplace, third-party agent app examples, and independent verification of such integrations working end-to-end.
